name: trvux-skills
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins: explanation/study-note formats (Cornell notes, Feynman/ELI5, IEEE paper, Socratic dialogue, worked examples, Zettelkasten), a usage-tracking hook, and a design-identity discovery process.

plugins.name: study-formats
plugins.description: Six explanation formats for studying and teaching: Cornell notes, Feynman/ELI5, IEEE paper format, Socratic dialogue, worked examples, and Zettelkasten notes.

plugins.name: quota-glance
plugins.description: Shows your Claude session (5h) and weekly usage limit plus a local token/cost estimate after every response.

plugins.name: design-identity
plugins.description: A consultative discovery process for finding a product's own distinctive design identity, instead of copying the surface look of reference sites like Linear, Framer, or shadcn.
